title: Day and Trial Passes: refund window, refund percentage, and cancellation terms
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: the number of hours after purchase within which an unused pass may be refunded, the percentage of the purchase price refunded, whether a refund may still be requested after the first visit is used, whether cancellation is allowed before the pass's validity window begins, and any flat fee retained on an eligible cancellation.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Refund window (hours after purchase) | Refund percentage | Refund allowed after a visit is used | Cancellation allowed before validity begins | Cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | 2 | 100% | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | 4 | 100% | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | 6 | 100% | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | 6 | 90% | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | 24 | 80% | No | Yes | 15.00 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | 0 | 0% | No | Yes | 0.00 |

The refund percentage is the share of the purchase price returned on an eligible cancellation for that tier. No tier allows a refund after the first visit on the pass has been used. Every tier permits cancellation before its validity window begins. Where a cancellation fee is set above zero, that flat amount is retained from the refund on an eligible cancellation of that tier; a value of zero means no flat fee is retained. The Corporate Guest Pass carries no purchase price to refund and defines no refund window, consistent with it being issued at no charge.
